verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents an official Browse CLI ([browserbase-probe-4]) built so agents can stay in the terminal for browser workflows ([browserbase-docs-24]). It sits alongside Skills that teach coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to drive Browserbase ([browserbase-docs-15]), which fits the AI-native framing. The evidence only shows that the CLI exists, not how deep it goes. Missing for 10: details on CLI command coverage (session management, fetch, deploy), installation and auth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
